description: List the ban lists Mizan reads, largest first: each list's name, who issues its bans, the games it covers, its bans and how many are in force, and whether Mizan is still reading it. Filter by game key or by part of the name.

game.description: A game key, such as rust, garrysmod, cs2, csgo, tf2 or squad; registry_stats lists every one.

limit.description: Lists to return, largest first. Defaults to 25.

name.description: Part of a list's name, such as "sourcebans".

name: list_sources

matched.description: Lists matching the filters, before the limit.

kind.description: Who issues the list's bans: anti_cheat, staff, platform, community

title: List the ban lists Mizan reads
